_comment: Voice-OS-agent tools for Clicky. OpenAI-Realtime/Hydra function schema ({type:'function', name, description, parameters}). Executed client-side by the Swift ActionRouter (and the web demo). Money/irreversible actions require confirm:true AND a prior spoken confirmation.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open / focus a macOS application by name (e.g. 'Spotify', 'Reminders', 'Google Chrome').

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open a URL in the default browser (e.g. a Stripe dashboard, a YouTube video, any site).

tools.name: play_music
tools.description: Play music on Spotify. Provide a free-text query (song + artist) or a spotify: URI. Starts playback.

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Set volume. target is 0-100. Use relative '-50%' style via 'change' if the user says 'down 50%'.

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder in the Reminders app and optionally open Reminders to confirm.

tools.name: check_calendar
tools.description: Read calendar events for a day to answer questions like 'who's speaking at my YC event Wednesday'.

tools.name: start_background_agent
tools.description: Kick off a long-running task in the background (e.g. 'set up a Google Ads campaign with reasonable defaults') and return immediately.

tools.name: order_food
tools.description: Order food via Swiggy using the user's logged-in session and saved payment. IMPORTANT: defaults to building the cart and PAUSING at payment. Only set confirm=true AFTER the user has verbally confirmed the restaurant, item, and price.

confirm.description: false = build cart, stop at payment for review; true = place the order
